spanish: Si nace el sol sobre él, sangres a él; pagando pagará; si no hay a él, y será vendido en su hurto.

findings.issue: Qal perfect 3fs of H2224 (rise/shine) is present 'nace', smoothing a completed rising into the sunrise idiom.

notes: Plural sangres, infinitive-absolute repetition, verbless דמים לו, and niphal passive stay within the tokens.
